candidate: Kervellec et al. 2024 Eurasian lynx recolonisation in the French Jura
scientific_target: survey-recorded grid-cell recolonisation between primary occasions, conditioned on realised occupied source cells in the preceding primary occasion

node_universe.definition: 100 km2 Jura grid cells sampled at least once during the study period
node_universe.response_independent_selection: sampling history rather than lynx detection status

response_semantics: A secondary-occasion detection is a lynx sign (e.g. track, hair, camera-trap image) recorded in a grid cell; the eventual once-only endpoint must preserve the authors' detection/non-detection and sampling-effort semantics rather than treating unsurveyed cells as zero.

prospective_estimability.reason: Published text reports 128/644 cells detected over three primary occasions but does not establish the frozen transition-specific event/non-event minima without outcome access.
prospective_estimability.execution_policy: continue response-blind only; exact count gate required before any model fit or heldout score

strong_external_comparators: authors' commute-time/circuit-theory spatial dynamic occupancy model
authors' least-cost-path spatial dynamic occupancy model
Euclidean-distance spatial dynamic occupancy baseline if reproducible from frozen code

allowed_gate0: file names, sizes, checksums and download URLs
forbidden_gate0: post-outcome model-selection results used to tune EOG

gate0_pass_requires: stable anonymous Zenodo record and exact file identities
complete 644-cell response-independent geometry or grid definition obtainable without opening lynx response rows
process_source_boundary: The claim is conditional on realised occupied cells inside the declared Jura sampling grid unless the published model/data explicitly represent external recruitment; no claim of globally closed lynx dispersal is made.
no_rescue: do not use the authors' fitted resistance parameter to choose EOG structural worlds after response access
do not change the 1-transition calibration / 1-transition heldout split after outcome access
do not lower exact count minima
do not add candidate-specific connectivity operators
do not read response rows merely to decide candidate eligibility
